title: account
description:
One synthetic bank account as the ingestion API accepts it.

account_type classifies the HOLDER, not the banking product. A savings account and a current account held by the same person are both INDIVIDUAL. There is deliberately no product value: the column cannot hold one, and mapping a product onto a holder type would record a claim the source never made.

status is observational. REVIEW_REQUIRED means somebody should look; there is no suspended, blocked or restricted value, because MULEGUARD does not take those actions.

created_at.description: When the account was opened. Account age feeds the new-account-with-high-throughput signal, so a missing or wrong value weakens detection rather than breaking it.

metadata_json.description: Free-form synthetic context. Sanitised on ingestion: keys that look like secrets, tokens, raw identifiers, ground-truth labels, scenario ids or ring ids are dropped rather than stored.
